items.title: TerminalFix campaign deploys a reverse tunnel through multistage intrusion
items.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence provides analysis of a ClickFix campaign that uses fake CAPTCHA prompts, DLL sideloading, and a reverse tunnel, with detections and hunting guidance. The post TerminalFix campaign deploys a reverse tunnel through multistage intrusion appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog .
items.content: In this article Attack chain overview Mitigation and protection guidance Learn more Microsoft Threat Intelligence has observed a TerminalFix campaign, a variant of ClickFix, targeting organizations across multiple industries. The campaign uses compromised websites to display a fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA verification overlay that tricks users into copying and executing a malicious PowerShell command.
items.author: Microsoft Security Research, Sagar Patil, Suriyaraj Natarajan and Parasharan Raghavan
